KP v0.2.59 — Fix 4 Critical Animation & Import Issues

- FK Chain relative rotation: lower limb now properly follows upper limb rotation instead of being absolute to torso
- SVG transform support: added matrix(a,b,c,d,e,f), skewX, skewY alongside translate/rotate/scale
- W3C Named colors: expanded from 18 to all 148 standard SVG colors (no more transparent shapes)
- Role classifier alignment: C# now recognizes forearm, fa, shin, and keeps eyes/mouth separate from face
